div.head: II Em 4
div.ab: Eac ic cyðe, þæt ic nelle socne habban to minum hirede, ær he hæbbe godcunde bote underfangen ⁊ wið þa mægðer gebet on bote befangen ⁊ to ælcum rihte gebogen, swa biscop him tæce, ðe hit on his scyre sy.

Eac ic cyðe, þæt ic nelle socne habban to minum hirede, ær he hæbbe godcunde bote underfangan ⁊ wið ða mægðe gebet on bote befangen ⁊ to ælcum rihte gebogen, swa biscop him tæce, ðe hit on his scyre sy.

Amplius indico, quod eum qui sanguinem fundet humanum nolo socnam habere in familiam meam, antequam diuinam emendationem susceperit et ad omne rectum inclinetur, sicut episcopus docebit, in cuius scira fuerit.

[Be blodgeote.] [Ld] Eac ic cyðe, þæt ic nelle socne habban [þone ðe mannes blod geote] to minum hirede, ær he hæbbe g[od]cunde bote underfangen ⁊ wið ða mægðe gebet—on bote befangen—⁊ to ælcum rihte gebogen, swa biscop him tæce ðe hit on his scyre sy.

Further, I declare that I forbid anyone [who commits homicide] to have right of access to my household, until he has undertaken to make amends as the church requires, and has made—or set about making—reparation to the kin, and has submitted to every legal penalty prescribed by the bishop in whose diocese it is.

Further, I make it known that I will allow no resort to my court before he [the slayer] has undergone ecclesiastical penance and undertaken the prescribed compensation to the kindred, and submitted to every legal obligation, as the bishop, in whose diocese it is, instructs him.

(Von Blutvergiessen. Ld) Ferner thue ich kund, dass ich (den, der Menschenblut vergiesst lq) nicht zu meinem Hofe Zuflucht finden [lassen] will, bevor er kirchlicher Busse sich unterzogen und gegenüber der Sippe [des Erschlagenen die von ihr] geforderte[?] Busse auf sich genommen und jeder Rechtspflicht sich unterworfen hat, wie der Bischof ihm vorschreibt, der es in jenes [Thäters] Sprengel ist.

(Of bloodshed. Ld) Further I make known that I will not [let] (him who sheds human blood, lq) find refuge at my court until he has undergone ecclesiastical penance and taken upon himself the compensation demanded[?] [by] the kindred [of the slain man] and submitted to every legal obligation, as the bishop in whose diocese that [offender] is prescribes for him.

note.label: repeats
note.quote: The repetition in 'II' of the ban in 'I' on a homicide's access to the king would then have been pointless

note.label: cf.
note.quote: II Em. Pr – Pr:1, 4, pp. 186–9. Cf. VI Atr. 36

div.note: H lacks the subject; Liebermann would supply from Ld ‘þone þe mannes blod geote’ (so Quadr.). H's ‘þa mægðer’ is corrected to ‘mægðe’ from Ld (B: ‘ðam ægðe’); ‘gebet’ perhaps for ‘gebeden(e) bote’. Liebermann compares I Em 3.
Following the interpretation of a rather corrupt passage, given by Liebermann, III, 127.
